reviews.title: Rock Solid with Custom Timings
reviews.comment: Got the 32GB 6400 kit, working rock solid at 6400 CL40 1.25v on an MSI Vector HX AI. I did have to dive into custom timings and voltage, but it's nothing too fancy.
reviews.author: Logan

reviews.title: Make sure you choose the right XMP profile
reviews.comment: At first ran in my laptop at flat 4800 mts JADED speed, i think it was my bad, i should have researched a bit more about my current model, be carefull, i had to learn this  the hard way, so based on my research my msi 16 hx ai supports up to 6400 mts, however only supports up to 5600 mts stable, thats why the ram speed was nerfed at 4800 mts, i tried to enable XMP profile in bios, started with the XMP profile 1 which runs  at 6400 and bricked my laptop lol so i had to reset my bios, hopefully my laptop model is from this year and it has a bios physical battery so i just unplugged and plugged back in and it came back to life, it was the worse experiencie i ever had this year xD. Lesson learned, afther resecting my bios, i  set the stable profile  3 which runs at 5600 mts CL40 and it runs wonderfull and stable.
reviews.author: Daniel H.

reviews.title: Awesome RAM for my Lenovo Legion pro 7 gen 8
reviews.comment: The memory started up fine after flashing the latest BIOS. I just went into the BIOS, installed the XMP profile and everything worked at 6400Mhz with an Intel i9 13900HX processor💪🏼
reviews.author: Aleksandr Zosimov

reviews.title: Great RAM, but be patient!
reviews.comment: Working great. When you first install it will be slow to start, DONT PANIC, wait sometimes it takes up to 20 minutes, the bios is adjusting. After the first boot it will still be a little slow booting up but by the 3rd time you restart your computer it will be very fast. I made the mistake of returning a couple of these at first because I didn't wait long enough. Be patient.
reviews.author: RICHARD BELCHER

reviews.title: Fasted SODIMM in the market
reviews.comment: This is a Hynix A die RAM - it is both the fastest DDR5 SODIMM RAM at stock and can be overclocked further the most out of all in the market.
